architecture_scope.positioning: A subtask-level model-routing plugin for DeepSeek Harness; no separate orchestrator is planned.
architecture_scope.dsh_responsibilities: Main agent, sessions, tools, native subagent execution and orchestration.
architecture_scope.generalrouter_responsibilities: Capability and task reference data, candidate matching, reported-quota admission, selection explanations and usage records.
architecture_scope.dispatch_ownership: The DSH main agent receives the first selection and explicitly dispatches native subagents. After failure, it decides whether to arrange a fresh worker on the same frozen model and effort; repairs bypass candidate matching.
architecture_scope.optimization_boundary: Cost and timing are recorded for evaluation. The current matcher does not establish cost or completion-time optimality.

repair_policy.selection: Inherit exact predecessor frozen provider/model/effort; no new task-weight estimate, candidate scoring or model substitution.
repair_policy.execution: New native subagent, existing workspace artifacts, inherited constraints and concise memento; main agent explicitly dispatches the returned ticket.
repair_policy.admission: Recheck the inherited enabled mapping, unchanged provider/model and quota admission. Do not check native catalog or allowlist membership; preserve the frozen effort. Mapping, quota or actual DSH invocation failures are reported to the main agent, not replaced.
repair_policy.records: Preserve predecessor outcome and acceptance; linked repair receives separate identity, ticket, outcome and usage. No autonomous loop.
repair_policy.legacy_path: append_task repair metadata and match on pending linked repairs return actionable guidance instead of selecting again.
repair_policy.evidence: Implemented only; no new runtime validation or experiment.

model_mapping_owner: Plugin bundles the 12 AA-to-callable-model/effort mappings. The user owns DSH App provider registration, allowed models and effort metadata.
dispatch_flow: DSH main agent uses the GeneralRouter planner skill and 12 human-defined semantic anchors to prepare task-profile.v3, normally with planner_estimated weights and a task-grounded rationale.
A Cordis ESM plugin registers generalrouter_match and sends the profile to the existing local Python CLI.

The matcher scores candidates and selects through enabled mappings and quota admission. Native catalog or allowlist membership does not exclude a candidate; optional model metadata only resolves first-selection effort.

Read applicable reported ECPA percentages and exclude explicitly exhausted applicable allowance; unknown percentage stays unknown. Issue a one-use dispatch ticket without deducting an estimated percentage.
The main agent explicitly calls DSH's native subagent tool with the selected provider/model and a supported reasoning_effort, or omits effort to use the selected model's default.
DSH owns worker execution and completion; the plugin records selections, actual dispatch settings, usage and timing.

dsh_adapter.implementation_style: Standard DSH npm tarball with prebuilt Cordis ESM entry point and a bundled Python runtime; retain main-agent dispatch ownership.
dsh_adapter.tool_registration: Export apply(ctx); register a tool using defineTool and ctx.tools.register().
dsh_adapter.subagent_backend: Prefer in-process spawn. Native model overrides are supported by in-process and DSH SDK backends, not by the official Codex, Claude Code or ACP subagent backends.
dsh_adapter.model_selection_setup: DSH owns child model selection and its allowed provider/model policy in Plugins > Subagent. Router no longer requires this projection to exist or contain a candidate before selecting it. Actual DSH invocation may still reject the request; this release does not change the policy or connect other plugin entry points.
dsh_adapter.route_mapping: Bundled explicit mappings resolve AA configuration IDs to exact model IDs already observed in the ECPA catalog. Missing host model metadata does not exclude an enabled mapping and does not prove it callable.
dsh_adapter.effort_policy: At first selection, optional model metadata supplies supported efforts: use the corresponding mapped effort when known supported, otherwise omit reasoning_effort and record a default fallback. Frozen retries and repairs preserve the exact selected effort without rechecking metadata. Actual DSH invocation remains subject to host rules.
dsh_adapter.skill_location_in_app_workspace: Bundled runtime/skills/generalrouter-task-profile registered with the DSH skill service for all workspaces; a same-name project skill takes precedence.
dsh_adapter.gateway: Use the user's configured compatible provider with the actual ECPA baseURL, API protocol, model IDs and secret source. The user completed one native-subagent smoke workflow in v0.1.4; provider and execution-backend configuration remain user-owned and are not changed by this release.
dsh_adapter.installation_after_package_exists: In DSH App, open Plugins > Add plugin, enter the absolute path to dsh-generalrouter-0.1.9.tgz, install and enable the bundle. Existing users update the package through App plugin management and start a new main session. Keep existing shared settings and project records. Leave projectRoot and hostConfig empty. Shared configuration and the bundled skill work across workspaces; no per-workspace copying is required. Same-name project or user skills still override the bundle and may need updating to use its new instructions. DSH provider registration, the native model allowlist and effort metadata remain user-owned.
dsh_adapter.project_path_defaults: Prefer session.header.cwd from main-session creation; use workingDirectory.get(session) only if that header is absent. Never infer the root from the package or DSH process directory. A nonempty projectRoot overrides the default. Bind the workspace when establishing a run and retain it across children, retries and records. A missing root is a setup error. Switching workspaces requires a new main session.
dsh_adapter.hook_boundary: Do not mutate subagent arguments from tools/pre-execute or assume subagent/start/end can reroute a call.

configuration_layers.merge: Object fields, including routes, merge recursively. Project settings may contain only changed fields. Missing optional host files retain the preceding layer; no external host file is required for built-in matching.
configuration_layers.path_origins: Relative routing_config, rates_file and quota_file paths resolve from the host configuration file that defines the field. A project-specified quota_file selects a complete quota file; do not mix account identities or credentials across layers.
configuration_layers.workspace_state: Relative state_dir always resolves from the current workspace. Absolute state_dir must stay inside that workspace. Task, usage and quota-cache state are separate per workspace.
configuration_layers.skill: Plugin registers the bundled planner skill across sessions. A same-name project skill may override it. Per-workspace skill copies are not required.
configuration_layers.missing_quota_connection: Keep allowance unknown and permit matching under the built-in defaults; unknown is not unlimited allowance.
configuration_layers.existing_project_files: Existing local host/quota files and project skills remain optional overrides. The plugin does not delete or overwrite them.

semantic_anchors.origin: Human-defined task examples with explicit reasons for their relative capability weights; not empirical AA task calibration.

task_profile_policy.planner_estimation: Use the four-dimensional definitions and closest semantic examples to estimate four nonnegative weights summing to one. Keep source_task_id and calibration_anchor_id empty; rationale records the analogy and adjustments.
task_profile_policy.unknown_policy: Use uncalibrated with four nulls for insufficient task information or central requirements outside the four-dimensional coverage. Missing matching AA samples alone does not require nulls.
task_profile_policy.historical_reference_fits: Retain exact and analogical bindings to the four Briefcase regularized reference fits with their original complete weights. Small-sample regression coefficients are not semantic ground truth for the manual examples.
task_profile_policy.compatibility: The source enum is extended within task-profile.v3. Existing legal profiles remain compatible and are not rewritten, including saved four-null plans; new profiles in new sessions adopt the new instructions.
task_profile_policy.reference_updates: Resources are bundled at fixed versions and may be updated with a later release. No live benchmark search or automatic periodic update is performed.
task_profile_policy.matching_boundary: Four-dimensional model capability snapshots and the 12 configurations retain their roles. Numerical task vectors still use the default 0.4 AA-category prior; four-null profiles use the explicit AA-composite fallback. Price, latency, difficulty and effort resource costs are not added to the selection formula.
task_profile_policy.measurement_boundary: Weight-source labels record provenance, not accuracy. No new public-benchmark runs or calibration claims accompany this update.

quota_adapter.implementation_style: Read the same CLIProxyAPI credential/model metadata and quota-request chain used by ECPA. No user-defined groups, account-to-group assignments or per-job percentage estimates.
quota_adapter.installed_version: Observed ECPA 0.3.46 with CLIProxyAPI core 8.0.34; collectors target explicit v8 or v0 configuration without probing versions.

current_upstream_management_routes.authentication: Separate management key supplied locally; never include it in public artifacts.

coverage.codex_oauth: Uses wham/usage. Keep returned usage percentages, primary/secondary/additional windows and reset times; these are not token balances or proof of coverage of every ChatGPT feature.
coverage.antigravity_oauth: Uses retrieveUserQuotaSummary and keeps group/bucket remainingFraction, resetTime and window.
coverage.gemini_api_or_vertex: No corresponding collector in the inspected ECPA quota service. Antigravity allowance cannot stand in for direct API or cloud billing budgets.

quota_adapter.polling_plan: Cold read on first active use; subsequent automatic reads at most once per 600 seconds while matching or workers are active. No idle timer or idle refresh. Failed reads are cached for the same interval.
quota_adapter.usage_collection: Use DSH execution records or the existing ECPA usage collection/export path. Do not add a competing destructive consumer to the core usage queue.
quota_adapter.admission_policy: Use only reported applicable percentages. Explicitly exhausted applicable allowance may exclude a route. Unreported, ambiguous or unscoped values remain unknown and do not by themselves block a route. The proxy retains account selection.
quota_adapter.ticket_semantics: A reservation_id identifies a one-use dispatch ticket; no assumed percentage is deducted and no settlement hold is computed.
quota_adapter.limitations: Cached provider percentages do not bound a future job's actual consumption or other clients. Unknown percentage is not unlimited allowance.

remaining_local_configuration: For a new installation, the user configures DSH App provider easy-cliproxyapi, native model allowlist and supported effort metadata once. Existing user settings are preserved.
Prepare the shared ECPA management connection and secret source once if reported allowance is needed; existing shared configuration is preserved and a missing connection remains unknown.

Install or update and enable dsh-generalrouter through App plugin management, then start a new main session in the actual workspace. No manual root/host paths, per-workspace configuration copies or skill copies are required unless a project-specific override is desired.
implementation_order: DSH matching tool and AA-to-callable route mapping
Quota snapshot collector and allowance admission policy
Usage, routing and timing records with API-equivalent cost accounting
The two-arm local translation-app case study

prior_release.source: User-reported smoke workflow and existing local run records; not a developer-run test.
prior_release.result: The selected Astra max native subagent created an addition webpage; a repeat match returned completed.
prior_release.scope: One workflow does not establish all-candidate compatibility, quality, lower cost, quota savings or a guarantee against allowance exhaustion.

current_release.work: Remove Router native catalog/allowlist prefiltering while retaining enabled mappings, quota admission, route identity and same-model repair. Update skill and documentation and generate artifacts. The v0.1.7 case remains separate historical evidence in docs/experiments/translation-ab-v2.
current_release.validation: No development tests, review, validators, compilation checks, simulated routing, API/model calls or developer plugin installation for this update.
current_release.configuration: Preserve shared connection settings and user DSH provider/backend configuration; do not read secret contents.
current_release.future_work: Public benchmark execution is deferred and contributes no results to this release.

distribution.contents: Prebuilt JavaScript entry point, DSH bundle patch, Python runtime, task-profile skill with 12 human-defined semantic anchors, required model/rate data and blank configuration examples.
distribution.external_configuration: Optional shared host.local.json and quota.local.json under $DSH_HOME/generalrouter, with optional project overrides. Installed package contents do not store local paths or credentials. Workspace task and usage state remains under that workspace.

bundled_model_mappings.external_overrides: Optional host.routes overrides built-in values; an empty object uses the complete plugin defaults.
